name: the second sundering
lore:
The Second Sundering was less a war and more a violent reclamation. For a decade, the world of Toril groaned like a titan waking from a fever dream. The very firmament fractured; stars fell like burning tears as the twin worlds of Abeir and Toril were finally wrenched apart.

Vast landscapes shifted overnight. Forests were swallowed by rising tides, and ancient mountain passes buckled, forcing beasts into desperate, unnatural migrations. Predators and prey alike huddled together in the shadow of tectonic upheaval, silenced by a primal dread. Magic, once a jagged and scarring plague, began to settle into the rhythmic pulse of the Weave once more. Men walked in a daze, their prayers met by a sudden, heavy silence as the gods withdrew behind the Veil. It was a time of profound unmaking, leaving the world scarred, yet breathing with a newfound, ancient clarity.
